_help: Join hub (join.html). positions: status is 'open' | 'rolling' | 'closed'. programmes: 'for' tags drive the finder chips: sjtu-ug | other-ug | highschool | grad | postdoc | intl. 'count' is filled automatically from theses.json projects when 'match' (substring of the programme name there) is given.

positions.topics_en: PRP · Zhiyuan Scholars · Chun-Tsung · 伯乐 · Summer internship · DAAD RISE · Graduation project
positions.topics_zh: PRP · 致远学者 · 䇹政 · 伯乐计划 · 暑期实习 · DAAD RISE · 毕业设计
positions.note_en: Several places every semester; tabletop muon experiments, detector building, simulation and analysis.
positions.note_zh: 每学期招收多位本科生：缪子桌面实验、探测器搭建、模拟与数据分析。

positions.topics_en: Precision muon physics · Detector R&D · Data analysis · Accelerator physics
positions.topics_zh: 精密缪子物理 · 探测器研发 · 数据分析 · 加速器物理
positions.note_en: Through TDLI or the School of Physics and Astronomy; international students welcome.
positions.note_zh: 通过李政道研究所或物理与天文学院招生；欢迎国际研究生。

positions.topics_en: Muon g−2 · muEDM · SHINE muon source · Muography
positions.topics_zh: 缪子g−2 · 缪子EDM · SHINE缪子源 · 缪子成像
positions.note_en: Competitive salary, international collaboration, and stays at Fermilab, PSI or J-PARC.
positions.note_zh: 竞争性薪酬、国际合作，以及在Fermilab、PSI或J-PARC驻站的机会。

positions.topics_en: 1–2 months · Particle-physics basics · Detectors & DAQ · Simulation · Tabletop muon experiments
positions.topics_zh: 1–2个月 · 粒子物理入门 · 探测器与DAQ · 模拟 · 缪子桌面实验
positions.note_en: For undergraduates from partner universities abroad; summer cohorts since 2025.
positions.note_zh: 面向海外合作高校本科生；自2025年起每年暑期接收。

programmes.desc_en: SJTU's flagship undergraduate research scheme; one or two semesters on a defined project.
programmes.desc_zh: 上海交大本科生科研的主渠道；围绕一个明确课题开展一到两个学期的研究。

programmes.desc_en: Multi-year research track for Zhiyuan College students, usually ending in a bachelor thesis.
programmes.desc_zh: 面向致远学院学生的多年期科研计划，通常以本科毕业论文收官。

programmes.desc_en: Funded undergraduate research with a final report and presentation.
programmes.desc_zh: 有经费支持的本科生科研项目，需提交结题报告并作口头汇报。

programmes.desc_en: Early supervised research for strong first- and second-year students, running to graduation.
programmes.desc_zh: 面向优秀低年级本科生的早期导师制科研，可持续至毕业。

programmes.zh: 大学生创新创业训练计划
programmes.desc_en: Team projects with an applied angle — our muography teams have grown out of this route.
programmes.desc_zh: 偏应用的团队项目——课题组的缪子成像团队正是由此成长起来的。

programmes.zh: 物理研究实践与毕业设计
programmes.desc_en: Credit-bearing lab research and bachelor-thesis projects in the School of Physics and Astronomy.
programmes.desc_zh: 物理与天文学院的学分制科研实践与本科毕业设计。

programmes.zh: 上海交大暑期科研实习
programmes.desc_en: One to two months in the lab for undergraduates from other universities, in China or abroad.
programmes.desc_zh: 面向国内外其他高校本科生的1–2个月实验室实习。

programmes.desc_en: Students from partner universities (UCL, Imperial, XMUM, UTM and others) join for the summer.
programmes.desc_zh: 来自UCL、帝国理工、厦门大学马来西亚分校、马来西亚理工大学等合作高校的学生暑期来组。

programmes.desc_en: German undergraduates placed with us through the DAAD RISE scheme.
programmes.desc_zh: 德国本科生通过DAAD RISE项目来组实习。

programmes.desc_en: Electronics and mechanical engineering students build real detector hardware.
programmes.desc_zh: 电子与机械专业学生参与真实探测器硬件的研制。

programmes.desc_en: Semester-long projects for motivated high-school students, with a tabletop muon detector.
programmes.desc_zh: 面向有志高中生的学期制课题，使用桌面缪子探测器。

programmes.zh: 李政道研究所访问学生
programmes.desc_en: Longer stays for students from other institutions working on a joint topic.
programmes.desc_zh: 其他院校学生围绕合作课题的长期访问。

programmes.en: Master's and PhD at TDLI / SPA
programmes.zh: 李政道研究所 / 物理与天文学院硕博研究生
programmes.desc_en: Apply through SJTU graduate admissions; write to us first so we can discuss topics and timing.
programmes.desc_zh: 通过上海交大研究生招生申请；请先与我们联系，讨论课题与时间安排。

programmes.desc_en: Positions on one of the four pillars, with time at the host laboratory abroad.
programmes.desc_zh: 围绕四大研究方向之一的岗位，含海外合作实验室驻站时间。

steps.en: Read about our four research pillars and pick one or two that excite you.
steps.zh: 阅读课题组的四大研究方向，选出一两个你感兴趣的。

steps.en: Email Kim with a short CV, which programme or position you have in mind, and a few lines on why.
steps.zh: 给Kim发一封邮件：附简短简历，说明你想申请的项目或岗位，以及简要理由。

steps.en: We reply with a time to talk — by video or at the lab — and, for students, a small starter task.
steps.zh: 我们会约一个时间交流（线上或来实验室），学生还会收到一个小的入门任务。
